src: Thomas Isidor Noel Sankara (December 21, 1949 - October 15, 1987) was a Burkinabé army major, fighter, communist revolutionary leader and president of the Burkinabé Republic of Faso from 1983 to 1987, seen as a charismatic revolutionary figure and nicknamed Che Guevara of Africa. src: Proteins are large biological molecules made up of a series of or more amino acids.
